text:
sam: Heads up — 503s spiking on /generate in hosted prod, started at ~22:00 UTC. Error rate ~8% over 5m. I'm spinning up a war-room, join if you can.
jess: On it. Can you post the bridge? I'll check request logs and canary variants.
mike: joining in 2m. grabbing recent nginx access logs and runtime traces.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-1832 — 503 spike on /generate. Pager duty notified.
nina: bridge: https://meet.example.com/r/redwood-warroom-42 —> join there. I'll open the dashboards: /dashboards/requests?panel=generate
sam: quick repro curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -i
```
mike: tailing logs: seeing upstream timeouts to model-proxy-02 at ~100ms then 504s. Error: "kv-cache miss" repeated. Pushing stack traces to #logs-snapshots.
jess: can we route to fallback model v2-quantized? it's compatible. Nina, can you add a temporary routing rule?
nina: adding rule: route '/generate' -> model:v2-quantized for 20% of requests as canary. Doing now. Will monitor
sam: FYI, latency is also creeping up for embeddings endpoint but not as bad. Probably shared infra.
mike: I can try restarting the model-proxy-02 container and flush its KV cache. Anyone okay with a quick restart? :thumbsup:
jess: +1 — do it. put it in maintenance mode first.
oncall-bot: Note: scheduled restart will create brief 1-2s 502s, automatic rollback enabled.
mike: restarting now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-proxy-02 -n prod` — monitoring logs.
(nice: 503s drop to ~1.2% over 90s)
sam: looks like restart helped, error rate down to baseline. Nina, can you keep the canary rule for 30m and then remove if stable?
nina: will keep and then TTL it at 30m. Also enabling extra logging for model-proxy-02.
jess: I'll follow up with an RCA ticket. Assigning to infra-team for deeper kv-cache investigation.
sam: thanks all. I'll close the incident once metrics stay stable for 15m. If it resurfaces, re-open thread or ping @oncall.
mike: logging notes pushed: https://logs.redwood.internal/snap/abc123
sam: adding brief postmortem draft to /incidents/INC-2024-1832.md — feel free to add details.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2024-1832 acknowledged by sam. Metrics stable for 5m.
jess: nice work team. :rocket:
